actions.title: Replace the five exit-127 shims with absolute version-pinned launchers
actions.launcherTemplate:
#!/bin/sh
# Pinned absolute launcher — <NAME> <VERSION> (GAP-BIN repair).
BIN=<ABSOLUTE_BINARY>
if [ ! -x "$BIN" ]; then
  echo "E_TOOL_NOT_INSTALLED <NAME> expected=$BIN" >&2
  exit 127
fi
exec "$BIN" "$@"
failureCases: setup-pipeline.sh no-op because bin/$tool exists -> use explicit install
